$comment: OMCA Archetype Router — model/provider configuration. THIS IS THE FILE YOU EDIT WHEN YOU NEED TO RETARGET AN ARCHETYPE. Each archetype points to a Honcho/9router COMBO NAME (not a direct model). 9router handles internal fallback chain + underlying model selection. The provider is `custom:9router` (registered in ~/.hermes/config.yaml). Combo names must also be registered as models in custom_providers.0.models (use `hermes config set custom_providers.0.models.<combo>.context_length <N> --force`). Plugin auto-reloads on mtime change. Identity prose lives ONLY in the SOUL_<name>.md file, NOT here.
_provider_notes: 9router runs locally and routes the combo name to one of the underlying models. Each combo (arc-*) has its own fallback chain INSIDE 9router (visible in the Honcho dashboard). The plugin does NOT see those internal fallbacks — 9router handles retry/upgrade/cheap-mode internally.

consultant._comment: Arc I — Raw Power Frontier. Combo arc-consultant1 (Honcho/9router). Underlying candidates: claude-opus-4-6-thinking, gemini-pro-agent, minimax/MiniMax-M3.

long_horizon._comment: Arc II — Long-Horizon Stable. Combo arc-longHorizon1. Underlying: minimax/MiniMax-M3, ollama/minimax-m3, gemini-3-flash-agent.

high_hallucination._comment: Arc III — Creative / High-Hallucination. Combo arc-highHallucination1. Underlying: nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free, nemotron-3-ultra-free, gemini-3-flash-agent. SHORT HORIZON — bounded by iteration count, not tool removal.

speedster_internal._comment: Arc IVa — Cheap / Fast / Distilled, INTERNAL variant. Combo arc-speedster1. Underlying: minimax/MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed. File reads only — NO terminal, NO web.

speedster_internet._comment: Arc IVb — Cheap / Fast / Distilled, NETWORK variant. Combo arc-speedster1 (same combo as IVa; 9router handles cost mode per call). Web fetches only — NO terminal, NO file. To split cost-mode behavior, register a separate `arc-speedster1-internet` combo in 9router and update this field.
speedster_internet._open_issue: speedster_internal and speedster_internet currently point to the same arc-speedster1 combo. If you want them to be different cost modes (e.g. one cheaper), create separate combos in 9router's Honcho dashboard and update the model fields.

_override_examples.$comment: Common retargeting scenarios. Edit the archetypes block above — do not edit this _override_examples block (it's documentation).

swap_consultant_to_gemini._note: Reorder via 9router's internal combo config, not here. To change which model arc-consultant1 prefers, edit it inside 9router's Honcho dashboard.

register_a_new_combo: 1. Create the combo in 9router's Honcho dashboard (e.g. 'arc-realtime1')
2. Register it in Hermes: hermes config set custom_providers.0.models.arc-realtime1.context_length 1000000 --force
3. Add an entry in archetypes.yaml and a new tool in plugin.yaml's provides_tools
5. Add the entry to this JSON's archetypes block
